Rashi on Arakhin 2a:10:1.hebrew: תני והדר מפרש - והוא הדין נמי מצי למנקט חד מהנך, אלא חד מתרתי תלת נקט. ל"א: להכי נקט האי, משום דפליגי רבנן ור"מ בהאי פירקא (לקמן ערכין דף ה.): המעריך פחות מבן חדש — ר"מ אומר: נותן דמיו, אדם יודע שאין ערך לפחות מבן חדש וגמר ואמר לשם דמים; וחכ"א: לא אמר כלום. ולהכי סתמה ברישא, לאשמועי' ממשנה יתירא, דאפי' לרבנן, היכא דאמר: "דמיו עלי", יש לו דמים ונותן דמיו. מפי מורינו:
Rashi on Arakhin 2a:10:1.english: [The Mishnah] teaches and then explains - And the same applies as well: [the Gemara] could also have cited one of those [other cases], but it cited one of two [or] three [possibilities]. Another explanation: For this reason it cited this [case], because the Rabbis and Rabbi Meir disagree in this chapter (below, Arakhin 5a): [Regarding] one who valuates [a child] less than a month old, Rabbi Meir says he gives his value, [for] a person knows that there is no valuation for [a child] less than a month old and he intended and spoke for the sake of [market] value; but the Sages say he has said nothing. And for this reason [the tanna] stated it anonymously at the beginning [of the tractate], to teach us through a superfluous Mishnah that even according to the Rabbis, where one said, "His value is upon me," [the child] has a value, and [the one who vowed] gives his value. [This is] from the mouth of our teacher.

Rashi on Arakhin 2a:11:1.hebrew: יורש - אדם שהפריש אביו קרבן, ולא הספיק להקריבו עד שמת:
Rashi on Arakhin 2a:11:1.english: An heir - A person whose father designated an offering and did not manage to sacrifice it before he died.

Rashi on Arakhin 2a:14:1.hebrew: קרבנו - גבי סמיכה כתיבי תלתא "קרבנו" גבי שלמים בויקרא, ודריש ר' יהודה לחד מינייהו: "קרבנו" — ולא קרבן אביו:
Rashi on Arakhin 2a:14:1.english: "His offering" - With regard to the placing of hands, "his offering" is written three times in connection with peace-offerings in Leviticus, and Rabbi Yehuda expounds one of them: "His offering" — and not his father's offering.

Rashi on Arakhin 2a:14:2.hebrew: תחלת הקדש - תמורה, שהיא תחלת הקדישה של בהמה זו:
Rashi on Arakhin 2a:14:2.english: The beginning of consecration - Substitution, which is the beginning of the consecration of this animal.

Rashi on Arakhin 2a:14:3.hebrew: סוף הקדש - סמיכה, שהוא סמוך לשחיטה:
Rashi on Arakhin 2a:14:3.english: The end of consecration - Laying on of hands, which is adjacent to slaughter.

Rashi on Arakhin 2a:16:1.hebrew: כל בעלי חוברין - חמשה שהביאו קרבן אחד בשותפות, כולן צריכין לסמוך עליו, ואין אחד סומך עליו:
Rashi on Arakhin 2a:16:1.english: All partners [in an offering] - [If] five [people] brought one offering in partnership, all of them must place [their] hands upon it, and one [alone] does not place [hands] upon it [on behalf of all of them].

Rashi on Arakhin 2a:17:1.hebrew: לית ליה - דס"ל: אחד סומך לכולם, ולא הוי כסומך על קרבן חבירו, הואיל והוא שייך ביה:
Rashi on Arakhin 2a:17:1.english: [He] does not hold [this] - For he maintains that one [partner] lays hands on behalf of all of them, and it is not considered like laying hands on the offering of another, since he has a share in it.

Rashi on Arakhin 2a:1:1.hebrew: הכל מעריכין - ערך כתוב בפרשה. (נדר: דמי עלי, ושמים אותו כעבד הנמכר בשוק):
Rashi on Arakhin 2a:1:1.english: All valuate - A valuation is written in the [Torah] portion. ([Whereas with a] vow: "My value is upon me," and they assess him like a slave sold in the marketplace.)

Rashi on Arakhin 2a:1:2.hebrew: מעריכין - אם אמר על אחד: "ערך פלוני עלי", נותן ערך אותו פלוני כפי שניו, שהערך ניתן לפי השנים הכתוב בפ' ערכין, בספר ויקרא ואחר שנות הנערכים הולכים:
Rashi on Arakhin 2a:1:2.english: Valuate - If one said about someone, "So-and-so's valuation is upon me," he gives the valuation of that so-and-so according to his years, for the valuation is given according to the years written in the [Torah] portion of Arakhin [in Leviticus do not submit], and one follows the years of those being valuated.

Rashi on Arakhin 2a:1:3.hebrew: נערכים - אם אמר: "ערכי עלי", או אם אמר אחר עליו: "ערך פלוני עלי":
Rashi on Arakhin 2a:1:3.english: Are valuated - If one said, "My valuation is upon me," or if another said about him, "So-and-so's valuation is upon me."

Rashi on Arakhin 2a:1:5.hebrew: נידרין - "דמי עלי", או אם אמר אחר עליו: "דמי פלוני עלי":
Rashi on Arakhin 2a:1:5.english: Are the object of a vow - [If one said,] "My value is upon me," or if another said about him, "So-and-so's value is upon me."

Rashi on Arakhin 2a:1:6.hebrew: נשים ועבדים - ומשלמין לאחר זמן, כשנתגרשה האשה או נשתחרר העבד:
Rashi on Arakhin 2a:1:6.english: Women and slaves - And they pay at a later time, when the woman is divorced or the slave is freed.

Rashi on Arakhin 2a:2:1.english: And a tumtum and an androgynos vow and are vowed - For they have monetary value.

Rashi on Arakhin 2a:2:2.hebrew: מעריכין - את אחרים. אם אמרו: "ערך פלוני עלי", נותנין ערך אותו פלוני:
Rashi on Arakhin 2a:2:2.english: Valuate - [They valuate] others. If they said, "So-and-so's valuation is upon me," they give the valuation of that so-and-so.

Rashi on Arakhin 2a:2:3.hebrew: אבל לא נערכין - אם אמר: "ערכי עלי", או אם אמר אחר עליהם: "ערך פלוני עלי", לא אמר כלום, שאין להם ערך, שזכר ונקבה אמורין בפרשה:
Rashi on Arakhin 2a:2:3.english: But are not valuated - If he said, "My valuation is upon me," or if another said about them, "So-and-so's valuation is upon me," he has said nothing, for they have no valuation, as "male" and "female" are stated in the [Torah] portion.

Rashi on Arakhin 2a:4:1.hebrew: מופלא סמוך לאיש - בן י"ב שנה ויום אחד, שהוא סמוך לאיש, ואינו איש עד שיביא שתי שערות. ומופלא קרי ליה על שם שבודקין אותו אם יודע להפלות ולפרש לשם מי נדר ולשם מי הקדיש, כדקתני בפ' יוצא דופן במסכת נדה (דף מה:):
Rashi on Arakhin 2a:4:1.english: A discerning [minor] close to adulthood - [A boy] twelve years and one day old, who is close to [being an] adult, and he is not an adult until he develops two [pubic] hairs. And he is called mufla because they examine him [to see] if he knows how to articulate and specify for Whose sake he vowed and for Whose sake he consecrated, as it is taught in the chapter [entitled] "Yotzei Dofen" in Tractate Niddah (45b).

Rashi on Arakhin 2a:5:1.hebrew: נערכין לאתויי מאי - כלומר: "הכל", דקאי נמי אנערכין — דאכולה מתני' קאי "הכל" — אהנערכין, לאתויי מאי:
Rashi on Arakhin 2a:5:1.english: Are valuated — what does it come to include? - That is to say: [The word] "all," which also applies to "are valuated" — for "all" applies to the entire Mishnah — regarding those who are valuated, what does it come to include?

Rashi on Arakhin 2a:6:1.hebrew: נדר בערכך כתיב - (נפשות משמע) איתקש ערכין לדמים, ומנוול ומוכה שחין אינן בדמים, ונודרין את אחרים, אבל לא נידרין, דאין שוים כלום:
Rashi on Arakhin 2a:6:1.english: "A vow, according to your valuation" is written - ([The word] "persons" implies [any living being]) Valuations are juxtaposed to [vows of] monetary value, and a disfigured person and one afflicted with boils are not subject to monetary value; and they vow [the value of] others, but are not vowed [themselves], for they are worth nothing.

Rashi on Arakhin 2a:7:1.hebrew: נפשות - משמע כל שהוא נפש. כולהו הנך דמייתי תיובתא, תני להו במתניתין בהדיא:
Rashi on Arakhin 2a:7:1.english: Persons - Implies anyone who is a soul. All of those [cases] that [the Gemara] brings as a refutation are taught in the Mishnah explicitly.

Tosafot on Arakhin 2a:14:1.hebrew: קרבנו - גבי סמיכה כתיבי תלתא "קרבנו" בויקרא, ודריש רבי יהודה לחדא מינייהו: "קרבנו" ולא קרבן אביו — לשון הקונטרס. ואגב חורפיה לא עיין, דהתם ליכא אלא תרי; ושמא "על ראשו" דכתיב התם חשיב ליה כמו "קרבנו", א"נ משאר "קרבנו" דריש:
Tosafot on Arakhin 2a:14:1.english: "His offering" - Regarding the placing of hands [semikhah], "his offering" is written three times in Leviticus, and Rabbi Yehuda expounds one of them: "His offering" — and not his father's offering — [this is] the wording of the Kunteres [Rashi]. And due to his sharpness [of intellect], he did not examine [the verses closely], for there [in connection with the placing of hands] there are only two [instances]; and perhaps [Rashi] considered "upon its head," which is written there, as [equivalent to] "his offering"; alternatively, [Rabbi Yehuda] expounds [it] from the other [instances of] "his offering" [written in the passage].

Tosafot on Arakhin 2a:14:2.hebrew: תחלת הקדש - תמורה, שהיא תחלת הקדישה של בהמה זו; "סוף הקדש" — סמיכה, שהוא סמוך לשחיטה — ל"ה. והאי דקרי ליה תמורה "סוף הקדש" בפרק הזהב (ב"מ נד:) — היינו לגבי קרבנו ראשון. וא"ת: לילף נמי שחיטה מסמיכה, ולא ישחוט יורש? הא ליתא, דאפילו שלוחו לא ממעט לשחיטה:
Tosafot on Arakhin 2a:14:2.english: "The initial stage of consecration" - [This refers to] substitution [temurah], which is the initial consecration of this animal; [and] "the final stage of consecration" [refers to] the placing of hands [semikhah], which is proximate to slaughter — [this is] the wording of the Kunteres [Rashi]. And that which [the Gemara] calls substitution "the final stage of consecration" in chapter HaZahav (Bava Metzia 54b), that is relative to his original offering. And if you will say: Let us also derive slaughter from the placing of hands, and an heir should not slaughter [the offering]? That is not so, for even an agent is not excluded from slaughter.

Tosafot on Arakhin 2a:16:1.hebrew: [קרבנו ולא קרבן חבירו - וא"ת: כיון דאמרינן ס"פ שתי מדות (מנחות צג:): "וסמך ידו" — ולא יד שלוחו, כ"ש לא יד חבירו, וא"כ "קרבנו" ל"ל? וי"ל]: אי לאו "קרבנו", אמינא: ד"ידו" למעוטי חבירו אתא, אבל שלוחו סומך. וא"ת: לילף מהכא בכל התורה דאין שלוחו של אדם כמותו, ואמאי יליף לה בקדושין פ"ב (דף מא:) דהוי כמותו? וי"ל: משום דסמיכה, ויבמה, ועגלה ערופה — שלשה כתובין הבאין כאחד, דכתיב ביבמה (דברים כה): "וקראו לו" — הן ולא שלוחן, וכן בעגלה ערופה: "ומדדו" — ולא שלוחם. וא"ת: לילף מינייהו דבכל דוכתא הוי שלוחו כמותו, מדאיצטריך למעוטינהו? וי"ל: דאי לאו הני קראי דקדושין דאשמועינן דשלוחו כמותו, הוה מוקמינן להני תלתא קראי דסמיכה, ויבמה, ועגלה ערופה לדרשא אחריתי:
Tosafot on Arakhin 2a:16:1.english: ["His offering" — and not his fellow's offering - And if you will say: Since we say at the end of chapter Shtei Middot (Menachot 93b): "And he shall place his hand" — and not the hand of his agent; all the more so not the hand of his fellow, and if so, why do I need "his offering"? And one can say:] If not for "his offering", I would say that "his hand" came to exclude his fellow, but his agent may place hands. And if you will say: Let us derive from here throughout the entire Torah that a person's agent is not like himself; and why does [the Gemara] derive in Kiddushin, chapter 2 (41b), that he is like himself? And one can say: Because the placing of hands [semikhah], a yevamah, and the heifer whose neck is broken [eglah arufah] are three verses that come as one [to teach the same law]; for it is written regarding a yevamah (Deuteronomy 25:8): "Then [the elders of his city] shall call unto him" — they, and not their agent; and similarly regarding the heifer whose neck is broken: "And they shall measure" — and not their agent. And if you will say: Let us derive from them that in every [other] place a person's agent is like himself, from [the fact] that it was necessary to exclude them? And one can say: Were it not for those verses in Kiddushin that taught us that a person's agent is like himself, we would have established these three verses of the placing of hands [semikhah], a yevamah, and the heifer whose neck is broken [eglah arufah] for another exposition.

Tosafot on Arakhin 2a:16:2.hebrew: כל בעלי חוברין - חמשה שהביאו קרבן בשותפות, כולן צריכין לסמוך עליו, ואין אחד סומך על ידי כולן:
Tosafot on Arakhin 2a:16:2.english: "All joint owners" - [If] five [people] brought an offering in partnership, all of them are required to place hands [semikhah] upon it, and one does not place hands on behalf of all of them.

Tosafot on Arakhin 2a:17:1.hebrew: לית ליה - דסבירא ליה אחד סומך לכולן, ולא הוי כסומך על קרבן חבירו, הואיל והוא שייך ביה — לשון הקונטרס. והכי משמע פרק שתי מדות (מנחות צד.): ומה תנופה שנתרבתה בשוחטין נתמעטה בחוברין, סמיכה שלא נתרבתה בשוחטין אינו דין שנתמעט בחוברין? ת"ל: "קרבנו" — לרבות כולן. אלמא למאן דאמר דלא דריש "קרבנו", מתנופה יליף ליה; ותנן התם: אחד מניף לכולם:
Tosafot on Arakhin 2a:17:1.english: "He does not hold [this]" - For he holds that one [partner] places hands on behalf of all of them, and it is not considered like placing hands on another person's offering, since he has a share in it — [this is] the wording of the Kunteres [Rashi]. And so it implies in chapter Shetei Middot (Menachot 94a): Just as waving, which was amplified [to apply] to slaughtered [animals], was limited regarding partners [joint owners], is it not logical that placing of hands [semikhah], which was not amplified [to apply] to slaughtered [animals], should be limited regarding partners [joint owners]? The verse states: "His offering" — to include all of them. Evidently, according to the one who says that he does not expound "his offering" [i.e., Rabbi Yehuda], he derives it from waving; and we learned [in a Mishnah] there: One waves on behalf of all of them.

Tosafot on Arakhin 2a:1:1.hebrew: הכל מעריכין - בנזיר (דף ב.) ובנדרים (דף ב.) הזכיר כינויים, שלא להזכיר שם שמים לבטלה, כדאיתא התם; ובכאן לא חשש להזכיר, שלא היו מזכירין שם שמים על הערכין. ערך כתוב בפרשה; נדרים, דמי עלי, ושמין אותו כעבד הנמכר בשוק:
Tosafot on Arakhin 2a:1:1.english: All take vows of valuation - In [tractate] Nazir (2a) and in [tractate] Nedarim (2a), [the Tanna] mentioned substitute designations (kinuyim) so that [people] would not mention the Name of Heaven in vain, as is stated there; but here, he was not concerned to mention [them], because they would not mention the Name of Heaven for valuations. [The amount of a] valuation (erekh) is written in the Torah portion; [whereas with] vows, [one says:] "My value is upon me," and they appraise him like a slave sold in the marketplace.

Tosafot on Arakhin 2a:1:2.hebrew: מעריכין - אם אמר על אחד בשוק ערך פלוני עלי (או אם אמר ערך אותו פלוני עלי), נותן לפי השנים הכתובים בפרשת שקלים, ולפי שנותיו הולכים:
Tosafot on Arakhin 2a:1:2.english: Take vows of valuation - If one said about someone in the marketplace, "The valuation of So-and-so is upon me" (or if he said, "The valuation of that So-and-so is upon me"), he gives according to the years written in the Torah portion of shekels, and they go according to his [the evaluated person's] years.

Tosafot on Arakhin 2a:1:3.hebrew: נערכין - אם אמר ערכי עלי, או אם אמר אחר [עליו] ערך פלוני עלי:
Tosafot on Arakhin 2a:1:3.english: Are evaluated - If one said, "My valuation is upon me," or if another said [about him], "The valuation of So-and-so is upon me."

Tosafot on Arakhin 2a:1:4.hebrew: נשים ועבדים - משלמין לאחר זמן, כשנתגרשה האשה או נשתחרר העבד; כן פ"ה. אי נמי, כגון שנתנו להם ע"מ שאין לרב או לבעל רשות בהם. ואפילו אין להם, נותנין עליהם מיד, כדתניא בתוספתא: נשים ועבדים נודרים ונידרים, אם יש להם בזמן הזה, גובין מהם; ואם לאו, [כותבין] עליהם וגובין לאחר זמן. ועבד, אע"ג דגבי מצות יש לו דין אשה, לפי ערך זכר הוא נערך; דלא אישתמיט תנא דלימא אם היה נערך כאשה:
Tosafot on Arakhin 2a:1:4.english: Women and slaves - They pay at a later time, when the woman is divorced or the slave is freed; so explained Rashi. Alternatively, [it is a case] where [someone] gave them [funds] on condition that the master or the husband has no rights in them. And even if they do not have [funds], [the obligation] is placed upon them immediately, as it is taught in the Tosefta: "Women and slaves vow and are the object of a vow; if they have [property] at this time, they collect from them; and if not, they write [a deed of debt] against them and collect at a later time." And a slave, even though regarding mitzvot he has the legal status of a woman, is valuated according to the valuation of a male; for no Tanna ever happened to say that he would be valuated like a woman.

Tosafot on Arakhin 2a:2:1.hebrew: טומטום ואנדרוגינוס נודרין ונידרין - שהרי יש להם דמים. ומעריכין את אחרים, אם אמרו ערך פלוני עלי, נותן ערך אותו פלוני; אבל לא נערכין, אם אמר אחד עליהם ערך פלוני עלי, לא אמר כלום, שזכר ונקבה אמורים בפרשה. ל"ה:
Tosafot on Arakhin 2a:2:1.english: A tumtum and an androginos vow and are vowed - For they have monetary value. And they valuate others: if they said, "The valuation of So-and-so is upon me," he gives the valuation of that So-and-so; but they are not valuated: if someone said about them, "The valuation of So-and-so is upon me," he has said nothing, for male and female are specified in the Torah portion. [This is the] wording of the Teacher [Rashi].

Tosafot on Arakhin 2a:3:1.hebrew: חרש שוטה וקטן - משמע דאית ליה דמים לחרש. והא דאמר פרק החובל (ב"ק פה:) חרשו נותן לו דמי כולו, בחרש שאינו יכול להתרפאות; אי נמי, פירש ר"ת דחרש בידי שמים אית ליה דמים:
Tosafot on Arakhin 2a:3:1.english: A deaf-mute, an imbecile, and a minor - This implies that a deaf-mute has monetary value [damim]. And as for that which [the Gemara] says in chapter HaChovel (Bava Kamma 85b): "[If] one deafened him, he gives him the value of his whole self" — [that is] in [the case of] a deaf person who cannot be cured; alternatively, Rabbeinu Tam explained that a deaf-mute [who is deaf] by the hands of Heaven has monetary value.

Tosafot on Arakhin 2a:4:1.hebrew: מופלא סמוך לאיש - בן י"ב שנה ויום אחד, שסמוך לאיש, ואינו איש עד י"ג ויום אחד. ומופלא קרי ליה על שם שבודקין אותו אם יודע להפלות ולפרש לשם מי נדר, לשם מי הקדיש, כדקתני פרק יוצא דופן (נדה מה:):
Tosafot on Arakhin 2a:4:1.english: A discriminating minor close to adulthood - [A boy] twelve years and one day old, who is close to [becoming] a man, but is not a man until [he is] thirteen [years] and one day [old]. And he is called "mufla" [discriminating] because they examine him [to see] if he knows how to articulate clearly and specify for Whose sake he vowed [and] for Whose sake he consecrated, as is taught in the chapter [entitled] Yotzei Dofan (Niddah 45b).

Tosafot on Arakhin 2a:5:1.hebrew: נערכין לאתויי מאי - כלומר, הכל דקאי נמי אנערכין, דאכולה מתניתין קאי הכל, (לאתויי נערכין) לה"ק:
Tosafot on Arakhin 2a:5:1.english: Are evaluated — to include what? - That is to say: [The word] "All" also applies to "are evaluated", since "All" applies to the entire mishnah; (to include [those who] are evaluated) that is why it says [this].

Tosafot on Arakhin 2a:5:2.hebrew: לאתויי מנוול ומוכה שחין - משמע דקאי נמי אעבדים דמתני'. ויש להקשות, דהא מיבעיא לן בפרק השולח (גיטין מב:) עבד שמכרו רבו לקנס מהו, אלמא אית ליה דמים! וי"ל, דהכא בטריפה איירי. וא"ת: ההורגו יתחייב, הואיל ואיתרבי בנפשות, אלמא איקרי נפש, דמהאי טעמא מרבינן להורג בן יום אחד פרק יוצא דופן (נדה מד:), ואף על גב דשמא נפל הוא? וי"ל, דהתם בתורת כהנים מוקמינן ליה בשכלו לו חדשיו; וכן מוקמינן התם לר' שמעון ב"ג, דאמר כל שלא שהה:
Tosafot on Arakhin 2a:5:2.english: To include a disfigured person and one stricken with boils - This implies that [this inclusion] applies also to the slaves of our Mishnah. And one can raise an objection: For didn't we raise a dilemma in chapter HaSholei'ach (Gittin 42b): If a master sold his slave for [the rights to his] penalty, what is [the halakha]? This indicates that he has monetary value! And one can say [in answer] that here it is dealing with a tereifah [one with a fatal condition]. And if you say: [If so,] one who kills him should be liable [for murder], since he is included [in valuations] from [the word] "souls" (nefashot), which shows that he is called a "soul" (nefesh) — for from this reason we include one who kills a one-day-old [infant] in chapter Yotzei Dofan (Niddah 44b), even though he might be a non-viable newborn (nefel)? And one can say [in answer]: There, in Torat Kohanim, we establish it as referring to [an infant] whose months [of gestation] were completed; and so too we establish it there according to Rabbi Shimon ben Gamliel, who says: Any [child] that did not remain [alive thirty days is of uncertain viability].

Tosafot on Arakhin 2a:6:1.hebrew: נדר בערכך נפשות - משמע דאיתקיש ערכין לדמים. מנוול ומוכה שחין אינו לדמים; ונודרין את אחרים, אבל לא נידרין, דאין שוה כלום:
Tosafot on Arakhin 2a:6:1.english: A vow according to your valuation, persons - [This] implies that valuations are juxtaposed to [vows of] monetary value. A repulsive person and one afflicted with boils are not subject to [vows of] monetary value; and they can vow [the value of] others, but are not vowed [themselves], for [such a person] is not worth anything.

Tosafot on Arakhin 2a:6:2.hebrew: כל שישנו בדמים נערכין כו' - לאו דווקא, דהא איכא דיקלא וארעא; אלא כל אדם שישנו בדמים קאמר:
Tosafot on Arakhin 2a:6:2.english: Whatever has monetary value is valuated, etc. - [This is] not exact, for behold, there are palm trees and land; rather, [the Gemara] means: "Any person who has monetary value."
